name: Merano (Italy)
description: Horizontal bicolour of red and white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Meran (a red eagle on white above a red eagle's claw and a grey arch).
history: Municipal flag of Merano, a comune in Trentino-South Tyrol; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Meran arms — red eagle on white above a claw and an arch
